source.note: The 2025 Monster Manual has a newer block that isn't in SRD 5.2.1; this one keeps the 2014 numbers until it can be checked against the book. Numbers follow the 2014 Monster Manual nothic; the 2024 block isn't entered yet. Entered from knowledge, not yet checked against the book. The Claws' +4 with 1d6 + 3 is as remembered and doesn't fit Strength 14 or Dexterity 16. Weird Insight is text only, and the AI doesn't pick Rotting Gaze yet (it uses save actions only with a recharge or in a Multiattack).

traits.name: Keen Sight
traits.summary: Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Rotting Gaze
actions.summary: DC 12 Con save by a creature within 30 ft or 10 (3d6) Necrotic as its flesh rots.

actions.name: Weird Insight
actions.summary: Pits its Wisdom (Insight) against a creature's Charisma (Deception) within 30 ft; on a win it learns a secret about the target.

summary: A one-eyed, clawed horror: a gaze that rots flesh and an uncanny knack for secrets.
